text: seow: "Strength is the signal (C26)." Strength yes, but C24 draws a line: a price 70% or more above the 200-day is sold into, never bought, and PRCH is past it. Add near 10% past the pivot (the C17 rejection edge), structure 61.1 weak and the sector only Recovering. On my method the distance from the 200-day is the disqualifier, not the signal. What clears me: a new sound base after the climax, broken on 1.4x volume.
